title: cdd-file
description: Structured second-line QA record for a single customer due diligence file. Captures file scope, customer profile, the four CDD pillars (CIP, beneficial ownership, nature-and-purpose / expected activity, ongoing monitoring), risk rating posture, EDD escalation posture, material gaps, reviewer findings, and the QA recommendation. The skill produces review artifacts only; the BSA officer or designated decisionmaker approves onboarding, sets or changes the rating, files SARs, or exits the relationship.

file_id.description: Canonical CDD file identifier (placeholder for sample). Stable across QA cycles.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this QA was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the QA review was last revised.

institution_type.description: Institution type. Drives which CIP and CDD rule the QA reads against.

operative_rule_set.description: Named CIP / CDD / EDD rules in scope for this file. E.g., 31 CFR §1020.220; CDD Final Rule; 31 CFR §1010.230; 31 CFR §1010.610 if correspondent; 31 CFR §1010.620 if private-banking.

review_type.description: What kind of CDD review this is. Drives evidence-ask weighting.

trigger.description: Event description if review_type is event_driven_refresh; null or empty otherwise.

customer_type.description: Customer type. Drives the beneficial-ownership scope read.

products.description: Products held or requested by the customer.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions in play for this customer.

identifying_info_collected.description: True when the file evidences collection of the operative CIP rule's required identifying information.

discrepancies.description: Discrepancies between customer-supplied data and verification sources, and how the institution resolved them.

beneficial_ownership.description: Pillar 2: Beneficial ownership for legal-entity customers under 31 CFR §1010.230. Not applicable to individuals or out-of-scope customer types.

applicable.description: False when the customer is not a legal-entity customer under §1010.230 or is on the rule's exemption list.

inconsistencies.description: Inconsistencies between certification and other file evidence (entity filings, signatories, public filings, transactional patterns).

boi_filing_status.description: BOI reporting status under 31 CFR §1010.380. The CTA implementing rule has live litigation history; mark `verify` and date the read when the rule-state is unsettled for this customer's entity class.

boi_status_as_of.description: As-of date the boi_filing_status was determined. Required when boi_filing_status is set to anything other than unknown.

expected_activity.description: Pillar 3: Nature and purpose of the customer relationship; expected-activity profile.

expected_volumes.description: For business customers: expected cash, ACH, wire frequency and counterparties; expected geographies; expected funding sources. Free-text where quantified figures are not provided.

ongoing_monitoring.description: Pillar 4: Ongoing monitoring scope and refresh posture.

threshold_calibration_note.description: Whether monitoring thresholds are calibrated against the expected-activity profile. Tuning belongs to aml-model-monitoring; cross-reference for findings.

risk_rating.description: Customer risk rating and the evidence underneath the drivers. The QA reads reasonableness; it does not set or change the rating.

current_rating.description: Rating per the firm's risk model. E.g., low / medium / high; or the firm's named tiers.

edd_status.description: EDD escalation posture. Where required_pending or borderline, the QA cross-references edd-escalation-pack rather than producing the EDD pack itself.

material_gaps.description: Specific evidence or documentation the QA reviewer flagged as missing.

qa_findings.description: Criteria-aligned findings against the CDD file. Each finding ties to a named criterion.

recommendation.description: QA recommendation. Consultative input to the BSA officer, AML QA team lead, or customer-onboarding compliance lead. The skill does not approve onboarding, set or change the rating, file SARs, or exit the relationship.

recommendation_notes.description: Detail behind the recommendation: what to escalate, what evidence to ask for, what cycle change to consider.

cross_references.description: Links to adjacent QA records for the same customer.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this QA artifact must clear before the recommendation is acted on. Drawn from references/review-gates.md when present.

owner.description: Role of the QA reviewer. E.g., second-line CDD QA reviewer, internal audit secondee, advisory engagement manager.

approver.description: Role that signs off the QA artifact. Typically BSA officer, AML QA team lead, or customer-onboarding compliance lead.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the QA read, per references/review-gates.md when present.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims in the QA. Every claim should be traceable.
